title: Pattern Bracelet Band
shareTitle: Pattern Bracelet Band 📿 — String a Pattern, Play a Song
description: Complete AB, ABC, and ABB patterns with chunky wooden beads, hear every shape become an instrument, then compose and save your own eight-step bracelet song.
learningGoals: Recognize and extend AB repeating patterns by color
Extend ABC and ABB patterns with two missing beads
Hear visual patterns as musical sequences and invent original patterns
Connect color order to sound and rhythm through playful composition
interactionModel: tap a wooden bead or drag it from the tray to a glowing slot; Play performs the eight-step circular sequencer; Free Jam adds rests, tempo, clear, and four local saves
feedbackModel: Correct beads snap in with their own instrument voice; wrong beads gently wiggle and trigger spoken/modelled hints; a finished bracelet earns a generated toy-stage concert

modes.title: Pop Pattern
modes.skill: AB pattern extension with musical playback

modes.title: Free Jam
modes.skill: invent and hear your own bead pattern as music
